---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement

---

## Problem this solves

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into. What are you trying to do that you currently can't?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. Be as specific as you can — which page, workflow, or role is affected?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## Who does this affect?

- [ ] Owner / Admin
- [ ] Dispatcher
- [ ] Technician
- [ ] Bookkeeper
- [ ] All roles

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other products, or any other context that would help us understand the request.
